headline: BRICS Delegation Enters Deadlock After Leaders Fail to Agree on Who Gets to Hold the Shared Powerbank
body:
The high-level diplomatic goodwill displayed at the BRICS summit dissolved into frantic negotiations behind closed doors this afternoon, as state leaders struggled to reach a consensus on who holds the single 20,000mAh powerbank tethered to the main negotiation table. Despite the outward displays of unity and hand-holding, sources close to the event confirm that the session was suspended for three hours when it became clear the device had only four percent battery remaining.

“It wasn’t a geopolitical disagreement; it was a matter of urgent charging priority,” explained Arjun Mehta, a junior protocol officer tasked with managing the summit’s cabling infrastructure. “We had three different heads of state simultaneously attempting to connect their devices to the same cable while reminding the others that their respective home countries had the most pressing firmware updates to download before the plenary session resumed.”

To bridge the impasse, the summit organizers eventually proposed a 'Tri-Lateral Charging Accord,' which would allow each leader exactly seven minutes of high-speed juice per hour. However, the plan hit a snag when the delegations realized the proprietary fast-charging cable was only compatible with the older model smartphone brought by a mid-level trade envoy who had already left for the airport.

As of this evening, the leaders have agreed to set aside the device entirely in favor of a stack of physical newspapers, though officials noted the tension remains high as every leader is now suspicious of the others’ backup battery packs. The summit is expected to conclude with a joint statement pledging to invest in more wall outlets for future meetings.
caption: Diplomacy is all about power sharing, literally. At least the hand-holding exercise helped keep the cables untangled for a few minutes. #BRICS #Diplomacy #PowerbankWars #SummitLife (satire)
